en.html:
Kageaki"...You returned to avenge your father?"
Kanae"...Well. If I said I had no such wish, that would be a lie."
Kanae"For Shishiku alone I should make the whole return journey? No. If revenge were my only business, I would have stayed abroad."
Kageaki"..."
Kanae"There are two reasons why I returned to Yamato."
Kanae"One... The duty that comes with this exalted blood. The people were feeding us, na. Protection was our side of the arrangement."
Kanae"With Yamato facing danger such as it has never known, what business have I sitting comfortably in some distant country? Whatever needs doing to save the people of the land, that much is my obligation."
Sayo"Bilkul. Precisely."

en.html:
I too nodded without speaking.

Haan. That was the arrangement. Nobility, properly understood, was supposed to work like this. Since ancient times, however, the duty had become steadily harder to remember. The rights? Those were remembering themselves magnificently. Growing stronger also.

Perhaps that was partly why the Ootori had lasted so long. Generation after generation, people like Kanae had remembered what their noble birth required of them...

Kanae"Though that child is more of an afterthought, actually. On her account I am not losing sleep. Frankly, I am not all that concerned."
Kageaki"What?"
Sayo"Indeed. Before madam left to study abroad, the sisters' fighting record was already approaching fifty-fifty, if I remember correctly."
Kanae"Wrestling I would win. Pitfall I would fall into. In that house even victory could not be trusted..."
Sayo"Such a gifted little calamity at foul scheming. One feared what would happen when she reached full size."
Kanae"Exactly. Nothing like me, thank goodness."
Sayo"And madam so gifted at foul violence. Arre wah, the family resemblance was hurting the eyes. Such gentle parents, and from them these two hell ki maharanis. What curse had entered the family planning?"
Sayo"Or were you both picked up from under a bridge? That would explain something."
Kanae"Nanny. A small doubt, and it is becoming bigger. In your understanding of master and servant, which one is supposed to be which?"
Kageaki"..."

Sayo"For now she is accepting the puppet's position. Forever? Nahin. From Hanae madam, that much cooperation would be a very foolish expectation."
Kageaki"I see..."
Kanae"Give her a few more years only. She will remove Shishiku and become head in fact as well as name, without anyone's assistance. That is what I meant: for revenge alone, no need for me to return."
Kanae"Leave it to my sister, and she will settle things far more elegantly, with much less trouble to everyone around her. If I push myself in, I only spoil that arrangement. Knowing this, what am I to do?"
Sayo"For Shishiku too, that arrangement promises more suffering. Hanae madam's cruelty is the genuine article. Quick killing? Why waste him? She would surely keep him alive and make the suffering last."
Kageaki"..."
Kanae"That is my sister for you. ...So the one I wanted to protect was not so much her as... the other one."
Kanae"Our cousin, Hanae's and mine. The rightful heir of the main Ootori house, whom Shishiku was searching for so desperately. ...It was him."
Kageaki"...? But—"

香奈枝「わたくしが出しゃばるより妹に任せておい た方がずっとスマートに、まわりへの迷惑も 最小限で片付くんですもの。 　それがわかっていては何もできません」
さよ「獅子吼殿にもその方が辛いでしょうなァ。 　花枝さまは真の残虐さを備えた御方、あっ さり殺すよりも生かしておいて延々と苦しめ 続ける方法を採られるに違いありませぬゆえ」

景明「……？ 　しかし」

Sayo"Minato sir, human relations do not consist entirely of politics. Thoda room we must leave for people."
Kageaki"...Yes."
Kanae"The complications were between the parents. The children had their own relations, you see. Hanae and I were both very fond of our cousin."
Kanae"Holding that little boy made me feel happy, somehow... Hanae felt the same, so there would be another fight over whose turn it was to hold him that day."
Kanae"Hanae: I am his betrothed. Me: I am his future elder sister-in-law. Therefore the right to hold him is mine. Both of us with excellent qualifications, and neither prepared to give way."
Kageaki"...I see."

Kageaki"Then, when you say you wanted to protect him—"

That sudden shine of red—my eyes went straight to it.

A thin line of blood ran from the corner of Kanae Ootori's neatly shaped lips. Somewhere she seemed to have bitten through: inside the lip, perhaps, or the cheek...

Grief was not only a feeling for her now. It had a taste.

en.html:
Her eyes held me there, feverish as if she were whispering love.

My knees were shaking. Even my bladder was giving warning: control might not remain with me.

This much desire to kill.
This much malice.

Her whole life, her whole soul—she meant to put everything into revenge on me.

Forgiveness? Impossible.
Being killed? Certain.

Now also. At this very moment.

Darr. So this was fear.

Never had I felt anything like it. No—perhaps until now I had known no fear at all. Whatever I had called fear before, this was the actual thing.

I wanted to run. To scream. Anything that might bring pity from another person, I was ready to do it.

I wanted to cry: forgive me, please.

...Would she?

Shame, dignity—chhodo, let them go. Any humiliation, any explanation. Apologize again and again. Promise to spend myself in atonement. If I did all that, perhaps...

Even this woman... might forgive me...

en.html:
Revenge, she said.
For Yuhi Nitta's cruel death, she would kill me.

Kageaki Minato would receive no forgiveness. None.
She would kill me.

————Ah.

Perfect.

Bilkul perfect. The person to condemn me.

A death for Kageaki Minato. An execution that fitted him.

This woman would kill me—to avenge Yuhi Nitta, whose life I had cut short!!

The best ending I could possibly ask for. Nothing above it. And suddenly it had come down from heaven, like a blessing.

So justice was there in this world. Judgment that refused to forgive evil—that also existed.

Bas. Beyond this... I wanted nothing.

ja.html:
復讐すると云う。
　新田雄飛の非業の死に懸けて、俺を殺すと云う。

　湊斗景明を決して許さず、
　殺してくれると云う。

　――――ああ。

　完璧だ。

　完璧なる断罪者だ。

　湊斗景明の為の死だ。

　相応しい処刑だ。

　この人が俺を殺してくれる。
　――新田雄飛の無念を晴らす為に!!

　望み得る限り、最高至上の結末。
　それは突然に天から降ってきた。

　恵みのように。

　この世に正義はあった。
　邪悪を許さぬ裁きは実在した。

　もう、これ以上……何も望むものはない。

en.html:
Kanae Ootori could not understand.

He might lose his senses and start screaming. That she had considered.
He might fly into a rage and attack. That also.

Crying, begging for his life—yes. Or accepting it, giving up, letting his head fall. All of these she had thought possible.

But this? For this there had been no place in her thinking.

————Gratitude.

Samajh nahin aaya. It made no sense to her.

Kageaki Minato was not someone Kanae Ootori could understand.
